subject: electronics

resources.title: Introduction to Electrical Engineering and Computer Science I - Circuits Unit
resources.notes: Introductory circuit representations, KVL/KCL, node/loop methods, design lab, exercises and self-check material.

resources.title: Circuits and Electronics (MIT 6.002)
resources.notes: Core undergraduate electronics curriculum covering lumped circuits, MOS transistors, digital abstraction, amplifiers, energy storage, dynamics, frequency-domain design and lab/design exercises.

resources.title: Microelectronic Devices and Circuits
resources.notes: Semiconductor physics, junction and MOS devices, device/circuit models, transistor circuits, amplifiers and integrated circuits.

resources.title: Solid-State Circuits
resources.notes: Graduate analog circuit analysis and creative transistor-circuit design.

resources.title: Analysis and Design of Digital Integrated Circuits
resources.notes: Graduate digital IC design including MOS models, energy, interconnect, timing, memory, testing, layout and SPICE projects.

resources.title: Integrated Microelectronic Devices
resources.notes: Graduate semiconductor device physics and design, including modern scaling issues; research level is supporting evidence, not standalone expert-readiness proof.

resources.title: Compound Semiconductor Devices
resources.notes: Compound-semiconductor physics, modeling, fabrication and electronic/optoelectronic device applications.

resources.title: Lecture Notes on Quantum Electrical Circuits

known_gaps: dedicated PCB design and fabrication curriculum remains incomplete
foundation hands-on component construction and bench-safety sequence remains thin
research references and graduate courses do not by themselves establish expert readiness
